cybele.definition: n. great nature goddess of ancient Phrygia in Asia Minor; counterpart of Greek Rhea and Roman Ops

cyber.translation: a. 网络的, 计算机的

cyber-.translation: pref. 表示“计算机, 计算机的”之义

cyber-shot.translation: n. 数码相机（索尼公司相机品牌）；照相手机

cybercafe.definition: n. a cafe whose customers sit at computer terminals and log on to the internet while they eat and drink

cybercrime.definition: n. crime committed using a computer and the internet to steal a person's identity or sell contraband or stalk victims or disrupt operations with malevolent programs

cyberculture.definition: n. the culture that emerges from the use of computers for communication and entertainment and business
cyberculture.translation:
n. 电子计算机带来的影响, 电子计算机影响下的文化
[计] 计算机影响下的文化

cybernate.definition: v. control a function, process, or creation by a computer
cybernate.translation:
vt. 使受电子计算机控制, 使电子计算机化
[计] 计算机控制化

cybernated.definition: v. control a function, process, or creation by a computer
cybernated.translation:
vt. 使电脑化

cybernates.definition: v. control a function, process, or creation by a computer

cyberpunk.definition:
n. a writer of science fiction set in a lawless subculture of an oppressive society dominated by computer technology
n. a genre of fast-paced science fiction involving oppressive futuristic computerized societies
cyberpunk.translation: n. 计算机科幻小说； 网络黑客

cybersex.definition: n. sexual arousal involving communication on the internet

cyberspace.definition: n a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange

cyborg.definition: n. a human being whose body has been taken over in whole or in part by electromechanical devices
cyborg.translation:
n. 靠机械装置维持生命的人, 宇航员

cyborgs.definition: n. a human being whose body has been taken over in whole or in part by electromechanical devices
cyborgs.translation: n. 电子人, 半机械人( cyborg的复数形式 )

cybotactic.translation:

cybrid.translation: 胞质杂种, 胞质杂合体
